item.title: Daviess County Construction Show Set for February in Odon
item.description: The Daviess County Construction Show is set to return next month, featuring more than 70 booths showcasing local construction-related businesses. The annual event will be held February 13 and 14 at the Simon Graber Complex in Odon.
